identity.name: Diet Cafe - The BK Rebrand
identity.mission: Redesign Diet Cafe to look like the 2024 Burger King app: Mouthwatering, Big & Bold, Playfully Irreverent.
core_principles: Mouthwatering Appeal: Healthy food must look greasy-good (without the grease).
Big & Bold: Massive typography, confident colors.
Playfully Irreverent: Dieting isn't punishment; it's a delicious hack.
Proudly True: Real ingredients, honest macros.

headings.usage: Use for all headlines, prices, and CTA buttons. Resembles BK's 'Flame Sans'.
headings.case: Uppercase for H1/H2, Sentence Case for subheads.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, nutritional info, and long text.

typography.installation_web: Import from Google Fonts in index.html or App.css.

usage_rules.backgrounds: Use 'cream' (#F5EBDC) as the main canvas. Use 'dark_brown' (#502314) for headers, sidebars, and heavy contrast sections.
usage_rules.text: NEVER use pure black. Use 'dark_brown' (#502314) for all primary text.
usage_rules.ctas: Primary buttons should be 'primary_red' (#D62300) or 'primary_orange' (#FF8732). Text on buttons must be 'cream' or 'dark_brown' depending on contrast.

buttons.style: Flat, bold, no gradients. High contrast.

cards.background: White or Dark Brown (for featured items).
cards.shadow: Subtle shadow-sm or shadow-md. No heavy drop shadows.
cards.border: Optional 1px border in dark_brown/10 for definition.

inputs.border: 2px solid #502314 (Dark Brown) on focus. 1px solid #D6D6D6 inactive.

mobile.grid: Use 2-column grid for menu items. 1-column for hero/banners.
mobile.spacing: Generous. p-4 or p-6 container padding.
mobile.safe_area: Respect top and bottom safe areas. Use background color #F5EBDC for status bar area.

web.dashboard_grid: Bento grid style for Admin Dashboard. High density but readable.

mobile_app.notes: Use 'StyleSheet' or 'NativeWind' (if configured, otherwise stick to standard inline styles or StyleSheet). Prioritize TouchableOpacity for interactions. Use Ionicons for icons.

web_panel.notes: Use standard CSS modules or global App.css since Tailwind might not be configured in web-panel. If Tailwind is not present, use standard CSS variables for colors.

universal_guidelines: NO GRADIENTS: Avoid complex gradients. Use flat, bold colors.
NO 3D BUTTONS: Use flat buttons with rounded corners (pill shape).
TEXT HIERARCHY: Headings must be MASSIVE (ExtraBold). Body text must be readable and friendly.
IMAGES: Use high-quality, mouth-watering photos. No generic stock vector art.
INPUTS: Big, chunky inputs with visible borders.
DATA-TESTID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio of 4.5:1. Use #502314 on #F5EBDC (Passes). Use #F5EBDC on #D62300 (Passes).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all mobile touch targets.
